description: This file contains cryptographic utilities and operations related to elliptic curve cryptography (ECC), including key hash computation, HKDF key derivation, EC point encoding/decoding, signature creation/verification, and handling of JWS messages for a Wi-Fi mesh security protocol.

classes.name: ec_crypto
classes.description: A namespace encapsulating elliptic curve cryptographic functions for key handling, hashing, encoding, signature, and message validation related to Wi-Fi mesh security.

methods.name: uint8_t * compute_key_hash(const SSL_KEY * key,const char * prefix)
methods.description: Computes a SHA-256 hash of an SSL key, including an optional prefix.

methods.name: size_t compute_hkdf_key(const BIGNUM * prime,const EVP_MD * hash_fn,uint8_t * key_out,size_t key_out_len,const char * info_str,const BIGNUM ** x_val_inputs,int x_val_count,uint8_t * raw_salt,size_t raw_salt_len)
methods.description: Derives a key using HKDF with specified inputs, supporting both legacy and OpenSSL 3.0 HKDF APIs.

methods.name: BIGNUM * calculate_Lx(ec_connection_context_t & c_ctx,const BIGNUM * bR,const BIGNUM * pR,const EC_POINT * BI)
methods.description: Calculates a specific BIGNUM based on ECC point and scalar operations, used for cryptographic computations.

methods.name: size_t compute_ke(ec_connection_context_t & c_ctx,ec_ephemeral_context_t * e_ctx,uint8_t * ke_buffer)
methods.description: Computes the derived key material ('ke') based on nonces and ECC point values for mutual authentication.

methods.name: size_t hkdf(const EVP_MD * h,bool skip_extract,uint8_t * ikm,size_t ikmlen,uint8_t * salt,size_t saltlen,uint8_t * info,size_t infolen,uint8_t * okm,size_t okmlen)
methods.description: Performs HKDF key derivation, using OpenSSL APIs depending on version.

methods.name: void print_bignum(BIGNUM * bn)
methods.description: Prints a BIGNUM in hex format.

methods.name: void print_ec_point(const EC_GROUP * group,BN_CTX * bnctx,EC_POINT * point)
methods.description: Prints EC_POINT's affine coordinates.

methods.name: uint8_t * compute_hash(const EVP_MD * hash_fn,size_t digest_len,const easyconnect::hash_buffer_t & hashing_elements_buffer)
methods.description: Computes a hash over a set of elements, used for various cryptographic digests.

methods.name: bool init_connection_ctx(ec_connection_context_t & c_ctx,const SSL_KEY * boot_key)
methods.description: Initializes a cryptographic context for ECC based on the associated SSL key and curve parameters.

methods.name: scoped_buff encode_ec_point(const EC_GROUP * group,const EC_POINT * point,const BIGNUM * prime,BN_CTX * bn_ctx)
methods.description: Encodes an EC_POINT into a byte buffer containing affine coordinates.

methods.name: EC_POINT * decode_ec_point(const EC_GROUP * group,const uint8_t * key_buff,BN_CTX * bn_ctx)
methods.description: Decodes a byte buffer into EC_POINT, given the group context.

methods.name: std::pair<const BIGNUM *,const EC_POINT * > generate_proto_keypair(ec_connection_context_t & c_ctx)
methods.description: Generates an ECC keypair and returns the private key and public point.

methods.name: std::optional<std::tuple<cJSON *,cJSON *,std::vector<uint8_t>>> split_decode_connector(const char * conn,std::optional<SSL_KEY * > signing_key)
methods.description: Splits a connector string into parts, verifies signature, and decodes JSON parts.

methods.name: std::optional<std::vector<std::string>> split_connector(const char * conn)
methods.description: Splits a connector string into header, payload, and signature parts.

methods.name: bool validate_jws_header(const cJSON * jws_header,std::string type)
methods.description: Validates the structure and content of a JWS header JSONObject.

methods.name: bool validate_jws_payload(const cJSON * jws_payload,bool check_expired)
methods.description: Validates the structure, fields, and expiry of a JWS payload JSONObject.

methods.name: std::vector<uint8_t> concat_nonces(const std::vector<std::vector<uint8_t>> & nonces)
methods.description: Concatenates multiple nonces into a single byte vector.

methods.name: EC_POINT * decode_jwk_ec_point(cJSON * json_web_key,BN_CTX * bn_ctx)
methods.description: Extracts EC_POINT from JWK JSON Web Key object.

methods.name: std::pair<EC_GROUP *,EC_POINT * > decode_jwk(cJSON * json_web_key,BN_CTX * bn_ctx)
methods.description: Decodes a JWK JSON object into an EC_GROUP and EC_POINT.

methods.name: std::optional<std::string> generate_connector(const cJSON * jws_header,const cJSON * jws_payload,SSL_KEY * sign_key)
methods.description: Creates a JWS connector string by signing header and payload with a private key.

methods.name: std::vector<uint8_t> gen_psk(const std::string & pass,const std::string & ssid)
methods.description: Generates a pre-shared key (PSK) using PBKDF2 from password and SSID.

methods.name: cJSON * create_jws_header(const std::string & type,const SSL_KEY * c_signing_key)
methods.description: Constructs a JWS header JSON object with cryptographic identifiers.

methods.name: cJSON * create_jws_payload(const std::vector<std::unordered_map<std::string,std::string>> & groups,SSL_KEY * net_access_key,std::optional<std::string> expiry,std::optional<uint8_t> version)
methods.description: Constructs a JWS payload JSON with groups, net access key, expiry, and version.

methods.name: cJSON * create_csign_object(SSL_KEY * c_signing_key)
methods.description: Creates a JWS signing object for cryptographic identity.

methods.name: EC_POINT * create_ppkey_public(SSL_KEY * c_signing_key)
methods.description: Creates a public EC point for the protocol's ECC key.

methods.name: bool add_common_jwk_fields(cJSON * json_obj,const EC_GROUP * key_group,const EC_POINT * key_point)
methods.description: Adds common fields (kty, crv, x, y) to a JWK JSON object.
